d: Atrium in the Palazzo dell'Aliaferia: it leads on one side to the apartments of the Count of Luna. Ferrando and many Count's Family who lie by the door; some Armed Men walk at the bottom.
Gardens of the palace: on the right marble staircase that puts to the apartments; the night is late, dense clouds cover the moon. Leonora and Ines.
Count.
Leonora and the Count.
Manrico and sayings.

A habitable diruto, on the foot of a mountain of Biscay; in the bottom, almost all open, burns a great fire. The first dawns. Azucena sits near the fire. Manrico lies next to her on a farmer and enveloped in her cloak; the helmet at her feet and in her hands the sword, on which she immovably looks. A band of Gypsies is scattered around.
Put it and say it.
Internal atrium of a retreat in the vicinity of Castellor. Trees in the bottom. It is night. The Count, Ferrando and some Followers advance cautiously enveloped in their capes.
Leonora with Ines and Séguito muliebre, then the Count, Ferrando and Seguaci, then Manrico.
Ruiz followed by a long line of Armati, and sayings.

Camping: on the right the pavilion of the Count of Luna, on which waves the flag as a sign of supreme command; from far tower Castellor. Sculpted by Armed Men everywhere; some play, others fortify the weapons, others stroll; then Ferrando from the pavilion of the Count.
The Count, coming out of his tent, looks at Castellor.
Ferrando and said.
Azucena, with his hands entangled, and dragged by the Explorers, a tail of other Soldiers, and sayings.
Room adjacent to the chapel in Castellor, with verone at the bottom. Manrico, Leonora and Ruiz.
Manrico and Leonora.
A wing of the Aliaferia palace. On the corner there is a tower, with windows secured by iron bars; dark night. There are two people who are shackled: Ruiz and Leonora.
The Count opens a door with a number of followers. Leonora steps aside as some advance.
Horrid prison: in a song, window with iron; door in the bottom; shady light hanging from the vault. Azucena lying on a kind of rough blanket, Manrico sitting at her out.
The door opens, Leonora enters: the eldest, in the last case the Count followed by Armati.
